message:
Hii {{frappe.db.get_value("User",doc.custom_assign_to_recruiter,"full_name")}}

I hope this message finds you well.

We have a new job requirement for the position of {{doc.designation}} that needs to be filled as soon as possible. Below are the details of the job requirement:

Job Title: {{doc.designation}}

Department: {{doc.department}}

Location: {{doc.custom_location}}

No of. Positions: {{doc.no_of_positions}}

Skills Required: {% for skill in doc.custom_skills %} {{ skill.skill }}, {% endfor %}

Please prioritize this role and begin the recruitment process at your earliest convenience. I am looking for candidates who not only meet the qualifications but also fit well with our company culture.

Let me know if you need any further information or if you would like to discuss the job requirement in more detail.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,

{{frappe.db.get_value("User",frappe.session.user,"full_name")}}
name: Job Requisition
subject: New Job Requirement Assignment: {{doc.designation}}
